title: RubricAtlas: Mining Type-Level Rubrics from Expert Reports to Evaluate Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep research agents conduct multi-step Web searches and synthesise retrieved information into analytical reports. Evaluating these outputs requires checking which analyses they deliver, beyond the presence of relevant facts. Query-specific binary rubrics make individual requirements explicit, but task-level checklists may leave the overall analytical structure underexamined. We introduce RubricAtlas, which derives type-level analytical requirements from expert reports on different objects within the same research type and organises detailed checks around recurring analytical questions. The requirements give related tasks a shared standard for what to analyse, without prescribing their answers. Our framework links binary checkpoints to report passages and evaluates completeness separately from argument validity. translated_title: RubricAtlas：从专家报告中挖掘类型级评分标准以评估深度研究智能体
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体执行多步骤网络搜索，并将检索到的信息综合成分析性报告。评估这些输出不仅需要检查相关事实是否存在，还需要检查它们提供了哪些分析。针对特定查询的二元评分标准能够使单个要求变得明确，但任务级检查清单可能使整体分析结构得不到充分检验。我们提出了RubricAtlas，它从同一研究类型下针对不同对象的专家报告中提炼出类型级的分析要求，并围绕反复出现的分析问题组织详细检查。这些要求为相关任务提供了关于“分析什么”的共同标准，而不规定其答案。我们的框架将二元检查点与报告段落关联起来，并将完整性评估与论证有效性评估分开进行。RubricAtlas基于3,079份中文金融研究报告构建，涵盖99种研究类型。参考报告选择实验……
tldr: RubricAtlas通过从3,079份中文金融研究专家报告中挖掘类型级分析要求，构建覆盖99种研究类型的评估框架，将二元检查点与报告段落关联，并把报告完整性与论证有效性分开评估，从而更全面地评估深度研究智能体。
en_tdlr: RubricAtlas mines type-level analytical rubrics from 3,079 expert financial research reports across 99 research types, linking binary checkpoints to report passages and separately evaluating completeness from argument validity to better assess deep research agents.
